item.title: MISSING JUVENILE – Have you seen Gabrielle?
item.description: Missing Person Alert: Help us locate Gabrielle Wright, 14, who was last seen around 9:30 a.m. December 13, 2025 in the 14400 block of Walters Rd. in Houston. If you have seen Gabrielle or have any information about her whereabouts, please contact: HCSO Missing Persons Unit: 713-274-9270 Crime Stoppers: 713-222-TIPS (8477) Email: HCSOMissingTipLine@sheriff.hctx.net
